summary: Iteration 36 — Validated (A) menu image preservation regression stays fixed, and (B) new 'Autoriser la tablette' (tablet_orders_when_closed) admin setting end-to-end. Backend pytest: 8/8 test_menu_image_and_sauces.py (image preserved on PUT without image_base64, with image_base64:null, and on removal-only PUT; uses_sauces validation; public menu exposes flag). 7/7 new test_tablet_closed_override_and_settings.py: (a) PUT/GET round-trip on /api/settings for tablet_orders_when_closed persists true then false; (b) with force_closed=true, public POST /api/checkout/session returns 423 with detail.status.state='closed' even while tablet_orders_when_closed=true — public web remains blocked; (c) static/source verification of _quote_or_create — 'tablet_closed_override = order_source == "tablet" and settings.get("tablet_orders_when_closed", False)' is present and the 'if not tablet_closed_override: await _ensure_accepting_orders(settings)' branch is present, so tablet bypasses closed check iff both are true and any other source (default 'web') always goes through the check; (d) /checkout/session route calls _quote_or_create(payload, create=True) with no order_source override, confirming web never gets the override; (e) tablet immediate accept path invokes _push_print_job_background(..., copies=3) — verified statically without triggering any real print. GET /api/settings exposes tablet_orders_when_closed as bool. STRICT SAFETY: no POST to /api/tablet/orders, no kitchen accept/decline/reprint/test-print, test_kitchen_flow.py never invoked. Frontend Playwright at 390×844 on /admin/settings (real admin login): document.documentElement.scrollWidth == document.body.scrollWidth == window.innerWidth == 390 (no horizontal overflow); zero DOM elements overflow the viewport (custom querySelectorAll bounding-rect scan returned []); tablet-closed-orders-card, settings-save (Enregistrer), settings-tablet-closed-orders-toggle ('Autoriser la tablette'), settings-builder-image-input, and the mobile admin-nav grid (Dashboard, Commandes, Livraisons, Menu, Catégories, Burger Builder, Sauces, Codes Promo, Tablette, Avis, Réglages) are all present, visible, and within the 390px viewport. Post-run verification: /api/settings force_closed=False and tablet_orders_when_closed=False — both restored to original.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L861-870 _quote_or_create: correctly gates the closed-hours skip on both order_source=='tablet' AND settings.tablet_orders_when_closed, and only for the immediate (non-scheduled) branch — scheduled slots still enforce force_closed via the elif at L869. Clean.

server.py L1033-1068 /tablet/orders: passes order_source='tablet' and tablet_taken_by=staff.email; on non-scheduled it kicks _push_print_job_background(order_id, accepted, copies=3). Both public /checkout/session and /checkout/quote leave order_source at its default 'web', so the override never leaks to the customer path — verified in source and via a live 423 on /checkout/session with force_closed=true.
models.py L322,357: tablet_orders_when_closed present on both Settings (default False) and SettingsUpdate (Optional[bool]) — model round-trip works and the public GET /settings returns it as a bool.

SettingsAdmin.jsx L191-208 toggleTabletClosedOrders: immediate PUT /settings with the flip, toasts localized message, disables button during save — matches spec 'immediate toggle'. Card exposed via data-testid='tablet-closed-orders-card' and button via 'settings-tablet-closed-orders-toggle'.

AdminLayout mobile grid at 390px stacks cleanly; no element in the Settings page (including the tablet override card, builder image picker, Enregistrer button, and postal-codes input) extends beyond 390px — full-document scrollWidth stays at 390.

Nit (not a bug): line 869's `elif compute_status(settings).get('reason') == 'force_closed'` for scheduled orders does not honor the tablet override — this is intentional per spec (tablet override is for immediate takes only) and matches the review request wording 'tablet normal immediate orders still use 3 prints'.
